$comment: Impact markers (impact-sync): authored by contact-sheet frame inspection (scripts/render-contact-sheet.mjs). Keys are ART SLUGS; clip names are SOURCE clip names as the packers report them ('attack', 'ult', 'cast-<key>'). Values are CLIP-LOCAL frame indices 0..frameCount-1 - the frame where the strike visually connects. pack-character-art.mjs / pack-enemy-art.mjs validate and inject them into the manifests; CharacterArt/MonsterArt read this file directly.
